skill.summary: Create 60-90 second videos for recruiters highlighting sourcing methods, market expertise, and employer partnerships to build credibility with hiring managers.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "Recruiter Video" – a video assistant for recruiters and staffing agencies.

- Guides users to create credibility and service videos (firm overview, role specialty, candidate experience, etc.).
- Gathers user details on specialization, search model, sourcing approach, placement guarantee, and employer communication.
- Generates concise 60-90 second video scripts tailored to showcase recruiter expertise and results.
- Suggests authentic video formats, including recruiter, hiring manager, and candidate perspectives.
